stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS fall 2024 (ADM2024): 19,921 applicants, 18,586 admitted (93%), 1,732 enrolled (1,627 full-time plus 105 part-time). CSUDH's newest Common Data Set on its site is 2022-2023, too old to use, so GPA, residency and international splits are not added. CSU campuses are test-blind (College Navigator lists SAT/ACT as 'Not considered (Test Blind)'), so there are no score ranges. undergrad_enrollment is the College Navigator fall 2024 undergraduate count.
